name: Somatra
source:
Somatra is a Sandbox/H-RPG set in a dystopian future, where Emperor Zion I expands the emperor's dominions over the galaxy by fear and war. The game takes place in Somatra, an imperial prison for bandits and government opponents.

Our main character, Alisa, has been transported there and imprisoned due to crimes committed by her mother, a top government scientist. Will Alisa be able to survive and keep her innocence in such a horrid place? Well, that will be up to you!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/somatra]Patreon[/url]]
